slides.title: One drawing, many copies
slides.text: You send one drawing to a friend. The network keeps a copy at each stop along the way, like stamps in Pim's sorting book.
slides.alt: Many Roads: the town map offers more than one road between the same houses, and a closed road is not the end.

slides.title: Copies kept safe
slides.text: The cloud is someone else's very big post office that keeps copies safe for you. A backup there saves your photos when a tablet breaks.

slides.title: Passed on without you
slides.text: A copy you send to a friend can be forwarded to others without you knowing. Once a copy travels on, you cannot call it back.

slides.title: The noticeboard test
slides.text: Before Pim sends a copy, Pim asks one question. Would this look fine pinned on the town noticeboard?
steps: a sunny drawing of a dog: fine to send
a private secret about a friend: keep it
not sure: ask a trusted adult first

slides.title: The Magpie's nest
slides.text: Pim warns that the Magpie keeps a copy of every shiny secret it finds. In its nest, those copies stay pinned up, forever.

words.means: one more version of the same photo or message
someone else's big computers that keep copies safe for you
a spare copy kept safe in case the first one is lost
to pass a copy on to someone else

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: Play Many Roads in Packet Post for 2 levels, tracing every copy's journey. Name one thing you would never send, because copies cannot come back.
